about: AIPAC Tracker (trackaipac.com) pages that are not person cards on its /tracker listing, so scripts/gen-aipac-tracker.mjs cannot place them. Each row is one roster pid, the tracker's own page path under /tracker/, and the headline figure exactly as that page prints it. Reviewed by hand against the live page on asOf; written into pdx-aipac.js by scripts/gen-aipac-tracker-pages.mjs. A pid already placed by the listing generator is never listed here.
